input.title: Give the FAQ search field the accessible name "Search questions"
input.rationale: The search input (#faq-search) has no accessible name. The visible <label>Search questions</label> just before it isn't linked to it: it has no for attribute and doesn't wrap the input. I can only edit the input itself, so this patch adds aria-label="Search questions", using the same words as the visible label so that voice-control users can say the text they see. A better fix needs an edit outside this element: add for="faq-search" to the <label> on line 10. That links the label natively, and clicking the label would then focus the field. If you do that, you can remove this aria-label. The fix should be checked with a screen reader.
